description: A three-pronged spear with a blue-tinged steel head and a shaft wrapped in what appears to be shark leather.  It feels perfectly balanced in your hands and hums faintly with the power of the deep ocean.  During Shark Call, the trident awakens — lashing out in front of you.
A cozy shark hoodie with a shark mouth on the front and a small dorsal fin on the back.  Two pockets on the front are perfect for storing sweets.  Activate it to pull the hood down.

use_action.msg: You pull the shark hood down.

description: A cozy shark hoodie with a shark mouth on the front and a small dorsal fin on the back.  The hood is pulled down over your shoulders, revealing more of your outfit.  Activate it to pull the hood up.

use_action.msg: You pull the shark hood back up over your head.
